s.note: Crunchy honeycomb broken into slabs and half dipped in dark chocolate, good after a dementor.
s.how: Boil 150g sugar and 4 tbsp golden syrup to amber, whisk in 2 tsp bicarb and pour into a lined tin to set. Break into slabs and dip half in 100g melted dark chocolate. Serve with 100g milk chocolate broken into rough pieces.

m.note: Beef chuck braised three hours in ale with carrots and crusty bread, Hogsmeade style.
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots with thyme. Add 375ml ale and 400ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with crusty bread and butter.

w.note: Soft condensed milk fudge, cut into squares and wrapped in paper.
w.how: Melt 395g condensed milk, 150ml milk, 450g brown sugar and 115g butter, then boil to 115C, stirring all the time. Take off the heat, beat 5 minutes until thick, pour into a lined 20cm tin and cool before cutting.

w.note: Crisp Earl Grey and lemon shortbread with a pot of tea. No Grim in the cup.
w.how: Grind 2 tsp Earl Grey tea leaves and beat into 200g butter with 80g icing sugar and lemon zest. Mix in 280g flour, roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Read the crumbs.

d.note: Butterscotch cream soda under a thick cream foam, served in tankards.
d.how: Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft, floppy peaks. Stir a tablespoon of butterscotch sauce into each tankard and pour in the cold cream soda. Spoon the cream foam on top and serve straight away.
